items.description: Most of the resources listed below provide lists and/or APIs to obtain (hopefully) up-to-date information with regards to threats. Some consider these sources as threat intelligence, opinions differ however. A certain amount of (domain- or business-specific) analysis is necessary to create true threat intelligence.
items.title: Sources

items.description: Standardized formats for sharing Threat Intelligence (mostly IOCs).
items.title: Formats

items.description: Frameworks, platforms and services for collecting, analyzing, creating and sharing Threat Intelligence.
items.title: Frameworks and Platforms

items.description: All kinds of tools for parsing, creating and editing Threat Intelligence. Mostly IOC based.
items.title: Tools

items.description: All kinds of reading material about Threat Intelligence. Includes (scientific) research and whitepapers.
